recipes.Title: Adzhar Style Khachapuri
recipes.Ingredients:
PASTRY
500g Plain flour
2 Eggs
15 g Yeast
200 ml Water or milk
2 tbsp Butter
1 tsp Sugar
Pinch Salt

FILLING
500g Cheese, mixture of cheddar, mozarella and feta
5 Eggs
1 tbsp Butter
recipes.Preparation:
Dissolve the yeast and sugar in the water/milk then add the salt. Add one egg, flour, butter and mix to form the pastry dough. Rest until the fermentation is complete and the volume has doubled.
Divide the pastry into 10 portions, roll into a round shape. In the centre of each put grated cheese. Level the filling over the circle up to 1 cm from the edge. Shape the edge of the circle to the form of a skirt, giving the appearance of a boat.
Bake at gas 7 (220°C) until nearly done. To the centre of each bread add a knob of butter, pour in an egg and replace in the oven. Bake until the egg has just coagulated, then serve.

recipes.Title: Bill's Onion
recipes.Ingredients:
4 Medium onions
500 g Puff pastry
2 Eggs, beaten with a splash of milk
60 g Butter
2 tsp Brown sugar
Salt
Black pepper
recipes.Preparation:
Heat the oven to gas 4 (180°C).
Peel the onions, cutting away a little more than usual. Cut a deep cross into the top of each onion.
Divide the pastry into four, roll each piece into a rectangle about 2 mm thick. Cut into 2 squares that are considerably wider than the onion. Sit an onion on a square of pastry then wedge about 15 g butter into the cross shaped cuts. Sprinkle with ½ tsp sugar, salt and a really big grind of black pepper. Paint the egg mix around the edges of the pastry. Lay the other pastry square over the onion and press down gently onto the bottom square. Crimp the edges with a fork and prick a small hole in the top. Paint the pastry with the egg mix and bake in the oven for 45 minutes until they are deep golden brown.

recipes.Title: Apple Tartlets
recipes.Ingredients:
500 g Puff pastry
4 Apples
6 tbsp Apricot jam, warmed and sieved to glaze

ALMOND CREAM
50 g Butter, softened
50 g Icing sugar, sieved
50 g Ground almonds
50 g Plain flour, sieved
1 Egg
recipes.Preparation:
Heat the oven to gas 6 (200°C).
Roll out the puff pastry  to 3 mm thick and cut into 4 x 12 cm discs. Prick the discs with a fork and lay on baking parchment on a baking sheet. Refrigerate for 20 minutes.
To make the almond cream, beat the butter then mix in the icing sugar, almonds and flour. Gradually add the egg until all mixed together.
Divide the almond cream between the discs and spread it over the top. Peel, quarter and core the apples, then slice as thinly as possible.
Arrange the slices on top of the almond cream so that they overlap and fan out from the centre. Cover the tarts with baking paper and put another baking tray on top to keep them flat while cooking. Bake for 15 minutes then remove the top tray and baking paper. Cook for another 10-15 minutes until the pastry is crisp, golden and cooked through. Brush with warm apricot jam to glaze before serving.

recipes.Title: Guacamole
recipes.Ingredients:
2 Ripe avocado pears
1 Shallot, chopped
1 Large tomato, peeled and chopped
1 Red chilli, finely chopped
Salt
Pepper
Lemon juice, to taste
recipes.Preparation:
Peel the avocados and remove the stone. Mash the 
flesh with a fork until fairly smooth. Stir in the chopped tomato, shallot, chilli and lemon juice. Season to taste and place in a covered bowl in the fridge until needed.

recipes.Title: Khachapuri from Puff Pastry
recipes.Ingredients:
2 kg Puff pastry

FILLING
1 kg Cheese, like gruyere or emmental
2-3 Eggs
3 tbsp Butter
200 g Sour cream
recipes.Preparation:
Roll the pastry to a sheet of 4-5 mm thick. Divide into 10 squares. In the centre of each square place the filling of grated cheese mixed with eggs and 2 tbsp butter.
Fold the edges of the square to the centre and press together, then roll the khachapuri to the shape of a circle.
Brush the khachapuri with egg yolk, lay in a water moistened pan and bake at gas 7 (220°C). When serving, pour some melted butter on top.

recipes.Title: Pan Haggerty
recipes.Ingredients:
900 g Potatoes
50 g Butter
2 Onions, finely chopped
1 tbsp groundnut oil
Salt
Black pepper
100 g Cheddar cheese, grated  (Gruyere, Abondance or Emmental cheese can be used as an interesting alternative)
recipes.Preparation:
Boil the potatoes in their jackets for 25-35 minutes until tender.
Drain and leave to steam dry for a few minutes. Peel and coarsely grate.
Heat the oven to gas 7 (220°C). Melt 1/3rd of the butter in a large frying pan and cook the onions for 5 minutes until beginning to colour. Combine them with the potatoes. Add another 1/3rd of the butter and the oil to a pan, scatter over half the potato and onion and season. Scatter over the cheese, then the remaining potato and onion, season and gently press down. Bake for 10 minutes. Loosen the pan haggerty, place a baking tray over the pan and invert. Melt the remaining butter in the pan and slide the pan haggerty back into the pan. Return the cake to the oven for a further 15-20 minutes until golden on top. Cut into wedges and serve.

recipes.Title: Straw Potato and Celeriac Cake
recipes.Ingredients:
500 g Potatoes, peeled
250 g Celeriac, peeled
1 tbsp Groundnut oil
50 g Butter
Salt
Black pepper
recipes.Preparation:
Coarsely grate the potatoes and celeriac and toss together in a bowl.
Heat the oil and 1/3rd of the butter, add the potato / celeriac mix. Press down with the back of a spoon, season and dot with another 1/3rd of the butter. Cook for about 20 minutes until a uniform golden brown, lifting the cake now and again to check the colour.
Loosen the cake and press the mixture down again then place a baking tray over the pan and invert. Add the remaining butter and slip the cake back into the pan. Fry for another 10 minutes until gold.

recipes.Title: Tomato and Chilli Salsa
recipes.Ingredients:
450 g Ripe tomatoes
1 Green chilli, finely chopped
½ Medium onion, finely chopped
1-2 tbsp Parsley, chopped
Salt
Pepper
1 tbsp Fresh lime juice
recipes.Preparation:
Peel the tomatoes by plunging into boiling water for 60 seconds and then removing the skin.
Chop the peeled tomatoes and place in a serving bowl, add all the other ingredients and stir, correcting the seasoning as necessary.

recipes.Title: Lemon Tart
recipes.Ingredients:
150 g Butter
95 g Golden icing sugar
30 g Ground almonds
1 Vanilla pod, seeds only
1 Lemon, + zest
1 Egg, beaten
250 g Plain flour

LEMON FILLING
6 Large eggs, 4 whole, 2 yolks
175 g  Golden caster sugar
3 Large lemons, juiced
1 Lime, juiced (total 150 ml with the 3 lemons + 1 lime)
200 ml Double cream
recipes.Preparation:
Place the butter in a food processor, beat until soft. Add the icing sugar, almonds, a pinch of salt, vanilla seeds, zest, egg and flour. Pulse until the pastry has just formed a ball. Flatten into a disc, wrap in cling film and refrigerate for 1 hour.
Butter a deep 23 cm loose based tart tin. Roll the pastry to about 30 cm on a floured surface. Press into the tin leaving about 2 cm over the edges. Chill until firm.
Heat the oven to gas 4 (180°C). Line the pastry case with paper, fill with beans and bake blind for 10 minutes. Remove the paper and beans and trim the excess pastry. Brush the pastry with the beaten egg white (left over from the filling) then bake for 5 minutes. Cool.
For the filling, whisk the eggs and sugar until smooth; add the lemon, lime juice and cream. Whisk and pour through a sieve into a jug.
Turn the oven down to gas 1 (130°C). Return the pastry to the oven on a baking tray and pour in the lemon filling. Bake for 35 minutes until just set. Turn the oven off and allow the tart to cool completely in the oven. Decorate with candied lemon.

recipes.Title: Lemon Tart (Gordon Ramsey)
recipes.Ingredients:
50 g Dark chocolate, melted
6 Eggs, 2 whole, 4 yolks
180 g Caster sugar
200 ml Double cream
2 Lemons, juiced
Icing sugar to dust

SWEET PASTRY
125 g Butter
90 g Caster sugar
1 Egg
250 g Plain flour
recipes.Preparation:
Place the sugar and butter into a food processor and whizz until combined. Add the egg and whizz for 30 seconds. Add the flour and whizz for a few seconds until the dough comes together. If it is a bit dry, then add 1 tbsp water. Knead lightly on a floured surface, shape into a disc and chill for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to gas 5 (190°C). Roll out the pastry and use it to line a 20 cm, loose- based tart tin. Rest for 30 minutes in the fridge. Line the pastry with paper and weight with baking beans. Bake blind for 15 minutes. Remove the beans and paper and bake for another 5 minutes until golden.
Brush the base with melted chocolate and cool. Lower the oven temperature to gas ½ (110°C).
Whisk the eggs, yolks and sugar together in a bowl and stir in the cream. Add the lemon juice; this will thicken the cream.
Strain the filling through a fine sieve into a jug. Pour half the filling into the pastry case. Place the tart on the bottom shelf of the oven, pull out the shelf half-way and add the second half of the jug. Slide the shelf gently back in and bake for 50-60 minutes until the filling is almost set; it should have a slight wobble in the centre. Trim the pastry level with the top of the tin and leave to cool completely.
Dust with icing sugar and run a cook's blowtorch over the surface to give a brulée effect.

recipes.Title: American Blue Cheese Dressing
recipes.Ingredients:
150 ml Sour cream
2 tbsp Good mayonnaise
2 cloves Garlic
1 tsp Salt
2 tsp Mustard powder
2 tbsp Olive oil
1 tbsp Balsamic vinegar
1 tbsp Lemon juice
40 g Blue cheese, crumbled
2 Spring onions, finely chopped
Black pepper
recipes.Preparation: Crush the garlic and grind with 1 tsp salt in a pestle and mortar. Add the mustard powder and grind in. Add the lemon juice, vinegar and oil. Mix together and mix the sour cream and mayonnaise. Whisk into the dressing ingredients. When all is thoroughly blended, add the chopped onions and the crumbled cheese. Season with black pepper.

recipes.Title: Gooseberry and Elderflower Ice Cream
recipes.Ingredients:
700 g gooseberries
75 g sugar
8 tbsp elderflower cordial

CUSTARD
275 ml whipping cream
3 egg yolks
50 g sugar
1 dsp liquid glucose
1 rounded tsp cornflour
recipes.Preparation:
Place the cream in a saucepan and bring to just below simmering point. Place the egg yolks, sugar and cornflour into a bowl and whisk until smooth. Add the glucose to the cream and whisk until the glucose has melted and blended with the cream. Pour over the egg mixture, then return everything to the saucepan and continue to whisk over a medium heat until the mixture thickens to a custard. Pour into a bowl, cover with clingfilm and allow to cool.
Top and tail the gooseberries and place into a saucepan with the sugar. Put a lid on the pan and cook over a low heat until soft, about 5 - 6 minutes. Place a sieve over a bowl and press the gooseberries through to extract all the pips.
Stir the elderflower cordial into the gooseberry purée and as soon as the custard is cool enough, combine the two. Freeze-churn until thick or pour into a polythene freezer box, cover with a lid and freeze until half frozen (about 3 - 4 hours). Beat the mixture in the box with a whisk, return to the freezer and repeat 3 hours later. Freeze until solid and store.

recipes.Title: Beef and Ale Casserole
recipes.Ingredients:
6 tbsp Plain flour
1.5 kg Leg of beef or braising steak
5 tbsp vegetable oil
3 Onions cut into wedges
750 g Carrots, cut into large chunks
400 g Parsnips, cut into large chunks
1 litre strong golden or brown ale
3 g Fresh thyme
2-3 Bay leaves, torn
Salt
Black pepper
recipes.Preparation:
Preheat the oven to gas 3 (170°C). Place the seasoned flour into a clean plastic bag. Dust the beef in the flour and fry in oil in a casserole until brown; do this in small batches. Transfer the meat to a plate and set aside.
Heat the remaining oil and add the onions, carrots and parsnips. Sauté over a low heat for 5-6 minutes until beginning to colour.
Return the beef to the casserole, pour in the ale heat and stir occasionally until it reaches boiling point. Add the bay leaves and thyme; cover and cook in the oven for 2-2½ hours or until the meat and carrots are very tender. Serve with leek and mustard mash.

recipes.Title: Chicken Basque
recipes.Ingredients:
1.75 kg Chicken, jointed into 8 pieces
2 Large red peppers
2 Medium onions
50 g Sun-dried tomatoes in oil
2-3 tbsp Olive oil
2 cloves Garlic
150 g Chorizo sausage, skinned and cut into ½ inch slices
225 ml Basmati rice
275 ml chicken stock
170 ml Dry white wine
1 tbsp Tomato puree
½ tsp Hot paprika
1 tsp Chopped fresh herbs
recipes.Preparation:
Joint the chicken and season well with salt and pepper.
Slice the peppers into quarters, de-seed and slice each quarter into 1 cm strips. Peel the onion and slice into 1 cm strips. Drain the tomatoes, wipe dry and cut into 1 cm pieces.
Heat the olive oil in a 24 cm casserole of about 4½ litre capacity and add the chicken pieces. Cook until a brown colour on all sides. Remove the chicken to a plate and add more oil. Add the peppers and onions and allow them to brown a little at the edges, moving them around for about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, chorizo and tomatoes and toss for a minute or two until the garlic is pale gold and the sausage has taken on some colour.. Stir in the rice and when coated, add the stock, wine, tomato puree and paprika. As soon as it has reached a simmer, turn the heat down to a gentle simmer. Add more seasoning, then place the chicken on top. Sprinkle with herbs, olives and orange wedges. Cover with a tightly fitting lid and cook over a very gentle heat for 50 - 60 minutes or in an oven at gas 4 (180°C) for 1 hour.

recipes.Title: Curried Nut Roast
recipes.Ingredients:
225 g Hazel, brazil or walnuts, finely chopped
2 Medium onions, finely chopped
1 Medium green pepper, finely chopped
75 g Wholewheat breadcrumbs
1 clove Garlic
1 tsp Mixed herbs
1 tbsp Curry powder
225 g Tomatoes, peeled and chopped
1 egg, beaten
Salt
Black pepper
recipes.Preparation:
Grease a 7 inch square cake tin.
Fry the onion and green pepper until soft (10 mins.)
Mix the nuts and breadcrumbs in a bowl and add garlic, herbs and curry powder.
Stir in the onion and pepper with tomatoes, mix thoroughly and season.
Add the beaten egg to bind the mixture.
Pack into the tin and bake for 30 - 40 minutes at gas 7 until golden.

recipes.Title: Glazed Hoisin Duck
recipes.Ingredients:
4 tbsp Hoisin sauce
1 tsp Five spice powder
2 Duck breasts
Oil
2 tbsp Sesame seeds
1 Green pepper, sliced into thin strips
3 Spring onions, shredded
2 Carrots, cut into thin strips
2 tbsp Sesame oil
recipes.Preparation:
Mix the hoisin sauce and five spice powder in a bowl. Score the duck diagonally and marinate in the sauce for 10 minutes.
Heat a little oil to a high temperature in a pan, shake the excess marinade from the duck and cook the duck skin side down for 5-7 minutes until the skin turns crisp. Turn the heat to medium and cook the breasts on the other side for 10 minutes brushing with marinade.
Meanwhile, lightly toast the sesame seeds in a frying pan. Mix the vegetables with the sesame seeds and sesame oil. Serve with the duck.

recipes.Title: Jamaican Curried Snapper
recipes.Ingredients:
1 tsp Coriander seeds
1 tsp Cumin seeds
1 tsp Black mustard seeds
1 tsp Black peppercorns
½ tsp Cayenne pepper
½ tsp Ground turmeric
3 tbsp Sunflower oil
40 g Butter
1 Large onion, finely chopped
2 cloves Garlic, crushed
5 cm Ginger, grated
1 tsp Soft brown sugar
1 x 200g Can chopped tomatoes
1 lime, juice only
1 x 400ml can of coconut milk
2 bay leaves
4 x 225g pieces red snapper fillet
salt and freshly ground black pepper
recipes.Preparation:
Grind the whole spices into a powder and mix with the cayenne and turmeric.
Heat the oil and butter in a large, shallow pan, add the onion and fry gently until just beginning to brown. Add the garlic, ginger, sugar and spices and cook for another 2-3 minutes. Add the tomatoes, lime juice, coconut milk, bay leaves and some salt and pepper and gently simmer for 10 minutes until thickened.
Add the snapper fillets, skin side down and spoon over the sauce. Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes, carefully turning the fish over halfway through. Remove the bay leaves and serve.

recipes.Title: Spaghetti Puttanesca
recipes.Ingredients:
225 g Spaghetti
Salt

SAUCE
Olive oil
1 small onion or 1-2 shallots
4 cloves Garlic
50 g Anchovies, drained
175 g Black olives, pitted and chopped
1 Fresh red chilli, de-seeded and chopped
2 tbsp Capers
450 g Tomatoes, skinned and chopped
2 tbsp Tomato purée
1 dsp Fresh basil, chopped
recipes.Preparation:
To make the sauce, heat the oil in a medium saucepan, add the garlic, chilli and basil and cook briefly until the garlic is pale gold. Add all the other sauce ingredients, stir and season with black pepper.
Turn the heat to low and let the sauce simmer without a lid for 40 minutes until thick.
While the sauce is cooking, boil the water with oil and salt and cook the spaghetti for 8 minutes.
Drain the spaghetti and toss with the sauce, adding the basil. Serve in hot bowls with plenty of parmesan cheese to sprinkle over.

recipes.Title: Smoked Bacon, Tomato and Pea Penne
recipes.Ingredients:
2 tbsp Olive oil
8 Smoked, streaky bacon rashers, cut into strips
1 Red onion, finely chopped
450 g Penne pasta
120 ml Dry, white wine
300 ml Passata
1 Large pinch chopped, fresh oregano
150 ml Double cream
100 g Frozen peas
Salt
Pepper
Freshly grated Pecorino cheese, to serve
recipes.Preparation:
Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the bacon for 2-3 minutes until lightly browned. Add the onion and cook for a further minute or two until softened.
Meanwhile, plunge the penne into a large saucepan of boiling, salted water. Cook for 10-12 minutes until al dente.
Pour the wine into the bacon and allow to reduce, then stir in the passata and oregano. Bring to the simmer and stir in the cream. Season to taste, cover and simmer for 5 minutes until slightly reduced and thickened. Stir in the peas and cook for another 3-4 minutes until tender.
When the pasta is cooked, drain, fold in the bacon mix, season to taste and serve scattered with the pecorino.

recipes.Title: Lamb kebabs, spicy with cashews
recipes.Ingredients:
350 g Neck of lamb, 20% fat to keep juicy
1 Small onion, quartered
1 clove Garlic
110 g Roasted and salted cashew nuts
3 tbsp Coriander leaves, chopped
Juice of ½ lime
1 Green chilli, de-seeded
Groundnut oil
1 tsp Cumin seeds
1 tsp Coriander seeds
Salt
Black pepper
recipes.Preparation:
Roast the spices over a medium heat until toasted. Transfer to a pestle and mortar and grind to a fine powder.
Cut the meat into small chunks , place in a food processor along with the onion, garlic, fresh coriander leaves, lime juice, cashews, spices and seasoning. Pulse the processor until a coarse sausage meat-like mix has formed.
Take tablespoon lumps and roll into  sausage shapes squeezing firmly. Should have about 12. Slide onto flat skewers, three each, cover with clingfilm and refrigerate for 2 hours.
Brush kebabs with oil and cook over charcoal .

recipes.Title: Granny's Spicy Apple Chutney
recipes.Ingredients:
455 g Onions, chopped
682 g Apples, sliced
455 g Raisins
4 cloves Garlic, crushed
682 g Soft brown sugar
4 tsp Salt
2 tbsp Ginger, grated
3 tbsp Mustard powder
2 tbsp Paprika
1 tbsp Ground coriander
1563 ml Malt vinegar
3 Green chillies, finely chopped
recipes.Preparation:
Cook the onions in boiling water for 5 minutes.
Add the remaining ingredients and heat to dissolve the sugar.
Bring to the boil and simmer over a very low heat for 3 hours.
Pour into hot, sterilised jars and seal.

recipes.Title: Sweet Pepper and Coriander Relish
recipes.Ingredients:
1 Fresh green chilli
1 Medium Red pepper
1 Small red onion
4 tbsp Fresh coriander leaves
4 tbsp Fresh lime juice
2 Large tomatoes, skinned, de-seeded and chopped.
Salt
Black pepper
recipes.Preparation: Place all ingredients in a food processor and blend until smooth.

recipes.Title: Windfall Chutney
recipes.Ingredients:
909 g Onions, chopped
2.27 kg Apples, sliced
57 g Garlic, crushed
57 g Ginger, grated
1 red chilli, finely chopped
1135 ml Malt Vinegar
510 g Soft brown sugar
2 tbsp Ground turmeric
1 tbsp Salt
recipes.Preparation:
Combine all ingredients in a pan.
Bring to the boil and simmer gently for 1 hour.
Pour into hot, sterilised jars and seal.

recipes.Title: Bruschetta
recipes.Ingredients:
1 tsp Balsamic vinegar
3 tbsp Olive oil
300 g Mozzarella cheese
175 g Cherry or baby plum tomatoes
Fresh basil leaves, torn
Wild rocket leaves
6 Thick slices of bread, toasted
1 clove Garlic
recipes.Preparation:
Toast the bread and while hot, rub over with half a clove of garlic, then drizzle with some olive oil.
Mix the vinegar with oil and season to taste. Stir in the mozzarella, tomato and basil leaves. Arrange the rocket leaves on the bread and place the dressing mix over the leaves.

recipes.Title: Frijolemole
recipes.Ingredients:
175 g Dried chickpeas, soaked overnight in cold water
1 tbsp Groundnut oil
1 Medium onion, chopped
2 cloves Garlic, chopped
3 Spring onions, finely chopped
1 Fresh chilli, finely chopped
2 tbsp Fresh lime juice
1 Large tomato, skinned and chopped
½ tsp Tabasco sauce
2 tbsp Coriander leaves, chopped
2 tbsp Sour cream
Salt
Black pepper

To garnish:
Black olives
Parsley
recipes.Preparation:
Drain the chickpeas and place in a saucepan with enough cold water to cover. Bring to the simmer and simmer gently with a lid for about 45 minutes until tender.
Heat the oil in a small frying pan and gently sauté the onion for 5 minutes, add the garlic and cook for another 5 minutes.
Drain the chickpeas and place in a food processor along with some salt, the sautéed onion and garlic and any oil in the pan. Now add the lime juice and blend until a smooth puree. If it's too thick, add some of the chickpea water. Should be like hummus in texture.
Empty into a bowl and add the tomato, chilli, spring onion, tabasco, coriander and 2 tbsp of sour cream. Taste to check seasoning and add more tabasco if necessary. Cover the bowl and chill. Serve garnished with black olives and parsley

recipes.Title: Piedmont Roasted Peppers
recipes.Ingredients:
4 Large red peppers
4 Medium tomatoes
8 Anchovy fillets, tinned, drained
2 cloves Garlic
8 dessertspoons Olive oil
Black pepper
1 Small bunch Basil leaves
recipes.Preparation:
Cut the peppers in half and remove the seeds, leaving the stalks on the halves. Lay the peppers in a lightly oiled, SHALLOW roasting tray. Put the tomatoes in a bowl and pour over boiling water. Leave for 1 minute, drain and slip the skins off using a cloth. Cut into quarters and place two quarters into each pepper half.
Snip one anchovy fillet per pepper half into rough pieces and add to the tomatoes. Peel the garlic cloves, slice them thinly and divide between the peppers. Spoon 1 dessertspoon of oil over each pepper half, season with the black pepper. Place the tray on a high oven shelf and roast for 50 minutes to 1 hour at gas 4 (180°C).
Transfer the peppers to a serving dish, with the juices poured over and garnish with a few basil leaves.

recipes.Title: Rice Paper Rolls and Peanut Sauce
recipes.Ingredients:
50 g Thin rice noodles
50 g Rocket
1 Red onion, sliced into half moons
2 Carrots, cut into matchsticks
1 Small bunch of coriander
12 Rice paper wrappers
1 Small bunch of mint, stems discarded

PEANUT SAUCE
5 tbsp Hoisin sauce
3 tbsp Smooth peanut butter
1 tbsp Sesame oil
1 tsp Chilli sauce
recipes.Preparation:
Mix the sauce ingredients in a small bowl, Add 3 tbsp water, mix again and then pour into a small serving bowl.
Pour boiling water over the noodles and leave for 3 minutes until soft. Rinse under cold water, drain, put onto a tea towel and cut into 12 cm lengths with scissors.
Put the vegetables, herbs and noodles in separate piles on a tray.
Pour hot water into a bowl then drop in the rice paper and leave for 30 seconds until soft. Remove and drain with kitchen towel. Put two mint leaves on the top portion of the wrapper and the vegetable mix on the lower side of the circle. Bring up the lower side of the rice circle over the vegetables and then fold in the sides. Roll up into a tight spring roll. Place seam side down onto a tray.
Serve the rolls whole or cut diagonally just before serving.
Serve with the peanut sauce.

recipes.Title: Rösti Crab Cakes
recipes.Ingredients:
225 g Crabmeat
150 g Waxy potatoes
2 tbsp Capers, drained and chopped coarsely
1 tbsp Fresh lime juice
1 tsp Lime zest
2 Spring onions, finely chopped
2 pinches Cayenne pepper
2 tbsp chopped coriander or parsley
Salt
Black pepper
Groundnut oil for frying
Lime quarters
recipes.Preparation:
Boil the unpeeled potatoes for exactly 10 minutes in salted water. Measure all the other ingredients into a bowl and mix thoroughly. When the potatoes are cooked, peel and grate coarsely into long strips.
Combine the grated potato with the crab mix. Form into eight cakes, cover with clingfilm and leave in a fridge for 2 hours to chill and firm.
Heat 1½ tbsp oil in a frying pan until very hot. Cook the cakes for 3 minutes a side turning the heat to medium.
Serve garnished with lime slices and chopped coriander or parsley.

recipes.Title: Seared Scallops and Parsnip Mash
recipes.Ingredients:
6-8 Scallops
2 Small parsnips, peeled and diced
2 Leeks
45 g Butter
7.5 g Lemon thyme
2 tbsp Fromage frais
recipes.Preparation:
Season the scallops and set aside.
Cook the parsnips in boiling, salted water for about 12-15 minutes, until tender. Drain and mash with a fork. Set aside.
Slice the leeks, wash thoroughly and drain. Melt 2/3rds of the butter in a frying pan and cook the leeks over a low heat for 7-10 minutes until soft. Stir in the parsnips, thyme and fromage frais. Season to taste.
Heat a frying pan and add the remaining butter. Pan fry the scallops for 2-3 minutes until golden brown. Spoon the leek and parsnip mash onto plates and arrange the scallops on top.

recipes.Title: Sweet Soused Herring with Salad
recipes.Ingredients:
4 Small herrings, filleted and trimmed

MARINADE
150 ml Water
100 ml White wine
3 tbsp White wine vinegar
1 tbsp Demerara sugar
1 tsp Pickling spices
2 Shallots
1 Bay leaf

SALAD
2 Medium potatoes
6 tbsp Olive oil
3 tsp Lemon juice
Salt
Pepper
½ Small cucumber
2-3 Medium beetroots, cooked
4 tbsp Sour cream
2 tsp Chopped chives
recipes.Preparation:
Sprinkle the herrings with salt and leave to drain for a few hours. Rinse and dry.
Add all marinade ingredients to a pan. Boil and simmer for 15 minutes. Cool and pour over the herring. Marinade in the fridge for 24 hours.
Boil the potatoes, cool and crush with a fork. Add 2 tbsp oil and 2 tbsp lemon juice. Stir in and season. Leave to cool.
Peel the cucumber and slice into 3 mm wide strips. Mix with salt and drain for 20 - 30 minutes. Peel and slice the beets into ¼ inch slices, season with salt and pepper. Add 2 tbsp sour cream to the potatoes along with 1 tsp chives.
Remove the herring from the marinade. Strain the marinade through a fine sieve. Whisk 4 tbsp of the strained marinade into the oil with the last of the lemon juice, season with salt and pepper. Use this to flavour the beetroot slices.
The potatoes can be made into a tower with slices of beetroot; 3 spoons of potato to 3 slices of beetroot.
Place the cucumber slices on top of the herrings.
Add the remaining chives (1 tsp) to the oil dressing and spoon over and around the plate with drizzles of the remaining sour cream.

recipes.Title: Thick Onion Tart
recipes.Ingredients:
PASTRY
50 g Self-raising flour
50 g Wholewheat flour
1 Pinch Salt
½ tsp Mustard powder
50 g Butter
40 g Cheddar cheese

FILLING
700 g Onions, finely chopped
50 g Butter
2 Eggs, beaten
110 g Double cream, yoghurt or milk
1 tbsp Cheddar cheese, grated
Salt
Black pepper4 servings
recipes.Preparation:
Grease an 8 inch flan tin.
Sift the flour, salt and mustard powder. Rub in the butter until crumbly.
Stir in the cheese. Add water until a dough forms.
Wrap and rest in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Melt the butter, add chopped onions. Cook slowly for ½ hour until deep brown and caramelised.
Roll out the pastry and line the flan tin.
Prick the base of the pastry and bake for 15 minutes at Gas 4.
Brush with beaten egg and bake for 5 minutes.
Spread the onions over the base. Whisk the eggs with the cream and seasoning. Pour over the onions and sprinkle with cheese. Bake for 30 minutes until golden.

recipes.Title: Tomato and Mozzarella Tarts
recipes.Ingredients:
375 g Puff pastry
4 tsp Basil pesto
2 Plum tomatoes, sliced
125 g Mozzarella, sliced
Olive oil
Salt
Black pepper
recipes.Preparation:
Preheat the oven to gas 6 (200°C). Cut the pastry into four circles each of 10 cm diameter. With a sharp knife, mark a 1 cm border around the edge of each circle then prick the centre of each piece all over with a fork.
Spread the pesto over the centre of the pastry, wrap in clingfilm and chill for 15 minutes.
Remove the clingfilm, arrange the tomato and mozzarella slices on top of the pesto then drizzle a little oil over and season.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve garnished with basil.

recipes.Title: Santiago Almond Torte
recipes.Ingredients:
300 g Whole, shelled almonds (skin on if possible)
4 medium eggs
250 g Caster sugar
Zest of one unwaxed lemon
1 tbsp lemon juice
1 tsp Ground cinnamon

For the lemon syrup:
Zest of 1 lemon
Juice of 1 lemon
25 g Caster sugar
Icing sugar to dust
recipes.Preparation:
Pre-heat the oven to gas 3 (160°C). Grease a 20 cm round, loose-based cake tin and line the base with baking parchment. Place the almonds in a food processor and whizz until finely ground.
Place the egg yolks, sugar, lemon zest and juice in a large bowl and whisk until the mixture becomes thick, creamy and pale. Mix in the almonds and cinnamon.
Place the egg whites in a clean, dry bowl and whisk until they form stiff peaks. Using a tablespoon, lightly fold 2 tablespoons of the egg white into the almond mixture to loosen it slightly, then gently fold in the remaining egg white until the mixture is thoroughly combined. Pour into the tin and bake for 45 minutes, or until a skewer comes out clean. Leave to cool in the tin.
While the torte is cooling, make the syrup. Reserve a few pieces of lemon zest for decoration. Place the rest with the juice, sugar and 1 tbsp of cold water in a small saucepan. Heat gently until the sugar has dissolved. Spoon the warm syrup over the top of the torte. Just before serving, dust with icing sugar then cut into slices and serve with a dollop of lightly whipped cream or natural yoghurt, decorated with the reserved lemon zest.

recipes.Title: Tartiflette with Brie and Bacon
recipes.Ingredients:
2 tbsp Vegetable oil
300 g Smoked, thick-cut, rindless, back bacon, chopped
1 Large onion, thinly sliced
7.5 g Fresh thyme
284 ml whipping cream
300 ml Semi-skimmed milk
3 Cloves garlic, crushed
Cayenne red pepper
Salt
Black pepper
1 kg Waxy potatoes (like Charlotte), peeled and thinly sliced
600g Ripe Brie, cut into thin slices (or Reblochon if available)
recipes.Preparation:
Pre-heat the oven to gas 4 (180°C) and lightly grease a 1.5 litre ovenproof dish. Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the bacon and onion over a medium heat for 4-5 minutes until beginning to brown.
Chop the thyme leaves, reserving a few to garnish. Place the thyme, cream, milk and garlic in a large pan; season with salt, black pepper and cayenne pepper. Bring to a simmer, add the potatoes, then cover and cook for 10-12 minutes. Stir in the bacon and onions and season with freshly ground black pepper. Place half the potato mixture in the base of the prepared dish, then top with half the sliced cheese, Repeat, finishing with a layer of cheese. Grind some black pepper over the top.
Bake in the oven for 40 - 45 minutes, until the potatoes are tender when pierced with a knife and the top is golden. Garnish with the remaining thyme and serve with a lamb's lettuce salad and chunks of Grand Mange Blanc bread.

recipes.Title: Chicken and Fennel Pie with Parmesan Pastry
recipes.Ingredients:
For the Pastry:
250g Plain, strong flour
½ tsp salt
1 tsp Caraway seeds
40g Strong Cheddar cheese, grated
25g Parmesan cheese, finely grated
126g Cold butter
1 Large egg, separated
2 tbsp Cold water

For the Filling:
2 - 3 Large cloves garlic
6 Large skinless chicken breast fillets
4 large fennel bulbs
2 tbsp groundnut oil
56g butter
¼ nutmeg, grated
56g Plain flour
4 Rounded tbsp Plain yoghurt
570ml Milk
450g Small tomatoes
Salt
Black pepper
recipes.Preparation:
Make the pastry first. Sift the flour and salt into a bowl and add the caraway seeds and cheeses. Cut the butter into small pieces and rub into the flour using fingertips until the mixture is crumbly. Using a fork, whisk the egg white lightly (reserving the yolk) with the water and add gradually to the flour mixture. Then press the dough into a ball, wrap it in clingfilm and refrigerate.
For the filling, cut the chicken breast fillets across into half inch pieces and slit the fennel bulbs lengthways. Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a high heat and toss the chicken and fennel pieces separately, transferring them to a plate on one side with a slotted spatula.
Now melt the butter in a large iron casserole, add the chopped garlic and the grated nutmeg and stir briefly. Remove from the heat and stir in the flour with a wooden spoon. Stir in the yoghurt, followed by the milk a little at a time. Return to a fairly high heat and bring to the boil for 2 -3 minutes, stirring all the time. Remove from the heat and season to taste. Add the chicken and fennel slices.
Heat the oven to gas 4 (180°C). Return the dish to a fast boil, stirring constantly then cover and put in the centre of the oven. Put the tomatoes in boiling water for a minute, then drain and skin. When the casserole has cooked for 45 minutes, add the whole tomatoes and return to the oven for another 15 minutes. Remove, check the seasoning and pour into a 3½ - 4 pint pie dish and leave until cold.
Roll the pastry on a floured board to just bigger than the pie dish. Dampen the edges of the dish and lay the pastry on top, pressing the edges with the back of a knife. Cut off the excess pastry, roll out the trimmings and use to rim and decorate the pie. Poke two holes for the steam to escape. Brush the pastry with the egg yolk and bake in the centre of the oven Gas 6 (200°C) for 30 - 40 minutes until brown.

recipes.Title: Pork Marinade
recipes.Ingredients:
3 tbsp Tomato ketchup
3 tbsp Dark soy sauce
3 tbsp Honey
1 tsp Mustard powder
recipes.Preparation: Gently heat all ingredients together and allow to cool. Coat the ribs in the mixture.

recipes.Title: Indonesian Chicken Sate
recipes.Ingredients:
340g Chicken breast
6 tbsp Soy sauce
Juice of one lemon
1 tbsp Soft brown sugar
1 Clove garlic
3cm fresh ginger root
4 tbsp Peanut butter
recipes.Preparation:
Cut the chicken into cubes. Combine the soy sauce, lemon juice, sugar, garlic and ginger. Marinate the chicken in the mix for 2 - 8 hours. Thread onto skewers.
Place peanut butter into a pan with 8 fl oz water and add the marinade juices. Heat and simmer for 3 - 5 minutes. Allow the sauce to stand.
Grill the chicken and serve with the sauce.

recipes.Title: Aloo Tikka
recipes.Ingredients:
675 g Potatoes, boiled and mashed
2 tbsp Coriander, chopped
1 Small onion, finely chopped
1 tbsp Ginger, minced
2 tbsp Curry paste
Salt
Oil for shallow frying

Batter:
100 g Gram flour
150 ml Water
recipes.Preparation:
Mix all the ingredients together and leave to marinate for ½ hour.
With a little oil in the palm of your hand, mould the potato mixture into small, round patties.
Make a thick batter with the gram flour. Heat the oil.
Coat the patties in the batter and fry each side for 5 minutes until crisp and golden brown.

recipes.Title: Cauliflower and Tomato Bhaji
recipes.Ingredients:
3 tbsp Oil
3 - 4 Bay leaves
1 tsp White cumin seeds
1 Large onion, finely chopped
2 Cloves garlic
1 tsp Ginger, minced
2 tbsp Curry paste
Salt
120 ml Chopped, tinned tomatoes
1 Medium cauliflower, cut into small florets
300 ml Water
recipes.Preparation: Heat the oil. Add the bay leaves, cumin seeds and onions. Fry for 5 minutes until the onions are soft and golden brown. Add the garlic and ginger. Fry until dark brown. Add the curry paste, salt and tinned tomatoes and stir-fry for a further 2 minutes. Stir in the cauliflower and water and bring to the boil. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until the cauliflower is just cooked.

recipes.Title: Lamb Mogli
recipes.Ingredients:
4 tbsp Oil
2 Large onions, finely chopped
6 Cardamom pods
4 Small sticks of cinnamon
4 Bay leaves
1 tsp Ginger, minced
2 Cloves garlic
2 tbsp Hot curry paste
4 tbsp Ground almonds
1 Small can chopped tomatoes
450 g Lamb, diced
90 ml Natural yoghurt
300 ml water
Salt
recipes.Preparation: Heat the oil and fry the onions, cardamom, cinnamon and bay leaves until golden brown. Add the ginger and garlic and fry until golden brown. Add the curry paste, ground almonds, chopped tomatoes and the lamb. Fry for 15 - 20 minutes. Add a little water to prevent sticking. Add the yoghurt and salt and fry for a further 10 minutes. Add the water, bring to the boil, cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until the lamb is tender. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves.

recipes.Title: Spicy Szechuan Pork ribs
recipes.Ingredients:
14 Spare ribs
Hoi Sin sauce
4 Red chillies
1 tbsp Dark soy sauce
1 tsp Ginger, pureéd
recipes.Preparation: Place the spare ribs on a foil lined baking tray. Mix the Hoi Sin sauce, chilli, soy sauce and ginger together and brush over the ribs. Cover with foil and bake in a pre-heated oven at gas 5 (190°C) for 1 hour. Uncover the ribs and return to the oven for 15 minutes at gas 7 (220°C)

recipes.Title: Yokel Pudding
recipes.Ingredients:
250 g Raisins
600 ml Dry cider
3 Large cooking apples, peeled, cored and sliced
125 g Walnuts, chopped
50 - 75 g Light brown sugar
A little cornflour and milk
250 g Shortcrust pastry
recipes.Preparation:
Soak the raisins in cider overnight. Empty the raisins and cider into a saucepan with the sliced apples and chopped walnuts. Bring to the simmering point, add the sugar, cover and cook until the apples are tender. Stir in the cornflour and milk mixture, which both thickens the filling and gives a glossy texture. Roll out the pastry thinly and use it to line an 8 inch flan dish. Fill with the apple mixture. Roll out the pastry trimmings and cut into thin strips to make a lattice on the top of the flan.
Glaze with a beaten egg, cover with buttered foil and bake in a pre-heated oven at gas 7 (220°C) for 30 minutes. Remove the foil for the last 10 minutes to let the pastry lattice brown. Serve with thick, double cream.

recipes.Title: Paella marinera
recipes.Ingredients:
225 g Mussels
225 g Clams
250 ml White wine
1.3 litres Chicken stock
Large pinch Saffron
4 tbsp Olive oil
8 Small chicken thighs, skin removed
450 g Raw shrimps, peeled
225 g Chorizo sausage, sliced
1 Medium onion, chopped
1 Red pepper, chopped
1 tsp Paprika
5 tbsp Fresh parsley
4 Tomatoes, chopped
675 g Spanish or risotto rice
225 g frozen peas
Salt
Black pepper
recipes.Preparation:
Pre-heat the oven to gas 4 (180°C).
Wash the mussels and clams in several changes of fresh water. Place them in a saucepan with the wine. Cover and cook briskly until they have opened, about 4 - 5 minutes. Lift the molluscs out, discarding any empty shells. Strain the broth and reserve.
Heat the stock with the mussel broth and saffron and simmer for 5 minutes. Heat the oil over a medium heat in a paella pan and brown the chicken pieces. Using a slotted spoon, transfer to a plate. Cook the shrimps in the pan for  about 2 minutes until just pink. Remove to the plate. Add the chorizo, onion, paprika and parsley to the pan and stir until the vegetables soften, then add the tomatoes and rice. Pour in the stock, stir and bring to the boil.
Put the rice mixture in a large, shallow roasting pan and add the chicken. Bake for about 25 minutes before adding the shrimps. Return the pan to the oven for a further 10 minutes. Arrange the mussels and clams over the surface of the rice. Cover the pan with foil and leave in the turned off oven for another 10 minutes or until the rice has absorbed the liquid.

recipes.Title: Chicken jambalaya
recipes.Ingredients:
3 tbsp Olive oil
450 g Chicken breast, cut into strips
1 Medium onion, chopped
2 Cloves garlic, finely chopped
1 chilli, finely chopped
1 Red or yellow pepper, chopped
225 g Cooked ham, cubed
340 g Kielbasa sausage, sliced
400 g Can of chopped tomatoes
340 g Long grain rice
2 tsp Fresh thyme, chopped
2 tbsp Worcester sauce
400 ml Chicken stock
Salt
Black pepper
Parsley as garnish
recipes.Preparation:
Pre-herat the oven to gas 4 (180°C).
Heat half the oil in a large heavy based frying pan and brown the chicken. Remove a put to one side. Add the rest of the oil and sweat the onions, garlic, chilli and pepper until tender. Stir in the ham, chicken and Kielbasa. Add the tomatoes, rice, thyme and Worcester sauce and season with salt and pepper.
Put the mixture in a casserole. Bring the stock to the boil and stir it into the rice mixture. Cover and bake in the oven for 1 hour or until the rice is cooked. Sprinkle with parsley and serve.

recipes.Title: Chicory Salad
recipes.Ingredients:
4 Chicory bulbs
2 Carrots
2 Crisp red apples
1 Large onion
60 g Raisins
200 ml Crème Fraiche
recipes.Preparation: Slice the chicory bulbs sideways into pieces. Peel and grate the carrots. Core and finely slice the apples. Peel and dice the onion. Mix all the above together with the raisins and crème fraiche. Arrange the pieces of chicory around the outside of a dish and place the mixture in the middle.

recipes.Title: Beef Cooked in Guinness
recipes.Ingredients:
2 tbsp Olive oil
650 g Stewing steak, cubed
1 Onion, sliced
2 Cloves garlic, sliced
625 g Carrots, sliced
2 tbsp Plain flour
750 ml Guinness
2 tbsp Soft, brown sugar
3 Bay leaves
Sprig of fresh thyme
250 g ready-to-eat prunes
Salt
Black pepper
recipes.Preparation:
Pre-heat the oven to gas 4 (180°C). Heat the oil in a flameproof casserole and brown a few pieces of meat at a time. Remove the meat and add the onion and garlic and cook for 5 minutes, then add the carrots and cook for a further 5 minutes.
Return the meat to the pan, sprinkle in the flour and stir. Slowly pour in the Guinness. Add the sugar, herbs and seasoning, bring to the boil and place in the oven for 1½ - 2 hours.
Add the prunes and cook for a further ½ to 1 hour or until the meat is very tender.

recipes.Title: Colcannon
recipes.Ingredients:
6 Medium potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks
1 Savoy cabbage, cut into large shreds
5 tbsp Double cream
5 Spring onions, sliced
50 g Butter, cubed
Pinch of nutmeg
Salt
Ground pepper
recipes.Preparation:
Cook the potatoes in salted water until tender. Cook the cabbage in boiling water for just 5 - 7 minutes so that it retains it's bite.
Gently heat the cream with the spring onions. Drain the potatoes and mash with the cream, spring onions and butter.
Add the cooked cabbage and season with nutmeg, salt and pepper. Mix and serve straight away.

recipes.Title: Ginger Beer
recipes.Ingredients:
370g Caster sugar
14g Fresh yeast
950 ml Warm water
2¼ tbsp Powdered ginger
recipes.Preparation:
Do not use any metal containers. Weigh out 8 oz sugar.
Cream the yeast with 1 tbsp sugar taken from the 8 oz and a little warm water. Leave for 15 minutes or until bubbles start to appear at the surface. Add the rest of the 8 oz sugar, the remaining water and 1 tbsp ginger. Cover and leave for 24 hours.
Add 1 oz sugar and 1 tsp ginger every day for 5 - 7 days.
Drain off the clear liquid into a bowl, leaving the sediment in the other bowl. Add 5 pints cold water to the ginger beer liquid, pour into bottles and cork. Leave for at least 2 days.
Divide the sediment in two, add sugar, warm water and ginger to each part as at the beginning (no yeast). Don't keep longer than 1 week for children. (Add the strained juice of 2 lemons?). Bottle then unscrew the top ½ turn. After 7 days, tighten the tops and leave for 2 weeks.

recipes.Title: Nettle Beer
recipes.Ingredients:
910g Nettle tops
3.8 litre Water
454g Demerara sugar
28g Cream of tartar
2 lemons
14g Fresh yeast
recipes.Preparation:
Wash the nettles and boil in the water for 15 minutes. Strain into a bowl containing the thinly sliced lemon rinds(no pith), add the lemon juice, sugar and cream of tartar. Stir well and leave to cool.
When cold, stir in the creamed yeast, mix well, cover and leave for 3 days at a temperature of 18 - 21°C.
Strain and put into screw top jars or bottles. Leave for a week before drinking.

recipes.Title: Goan Seafood Curry
recipes.Ingredients:
800 g Seafood (Prawns, pomfret, halibut or cod are good)
Juice of ½ lime
2 tsp Turmeric powder
Salt
8 Red chillies
1½ tsp Paprika
110 g Fresh coconut, grated
3 tsp Coriander seeds
2 Small onions, chopped
1 tsp Cumin seeds
1½ tsp Garlic, chopped
1½ tsp Tamarind pulp
2 tbsp oil
1 Tomato, peeled and chopped
3 Green chillies, slit lengthways
Chopped fresh coriander to finish
recipes.Preparation:
Place the chunks of seafood in a dish and mix with the lime juice, a pinch of turmeric, a pinch of salt and a little water. Leave to marinate for 30 minutes then rinse.
Soak the red chillies in 225 ml water for 15 minutes. Strain and reserve the water. In a blender, grind the red chillies, paprika, coconut , coriander seeds, half the onions, cumin seeds, turmeric powder, garlic and 1 tsp tamarind to make a fine and smooth paste. Add a little of the chilli water to facilitate grinding, which will take 7 - 10 minutes for a really smooth paste. Switch off the blender occasionally to prevent overheating.
Soak the remaining ½ tsp of tamarind in 110 ml water for 15 minutes, strain the reserved soaking water.
Heat the oil in a wide, shallow pan and fry the remaining onion until lightly coloured.
Add the spice paste and sauté the mix over a moderate heat until the paste becomes a deep orange colour. When the oil begins to separate from the spices to form globules on the surface of the paste, add 1 litre water. Add the tomatoes, green chillies and salt to taste and cook for 6 minutes. Taste and add the reserved tamarind water if desired. Add the seafood and cook for a few more minutes or until the seafood is done. Sprinkle with coriander leaves before serving.

recipes.Title: Apricot Pancakes with Honey-Orange Sauce
recipes.Ingredients:
115g Plain flour
2 Eggs
¼ tsp Salt
415 ml Milk
Oil for frying
340g No-soak dried apricots
1 tsp Ginger
5 tbsp Runny honey
Juice of 2 oranges
85g Melted butter
recipes.Preparation:
Make the batter with the flour, eggs, salt and milk using a whisk. Leave to rest for 1 hour.
Put the dried apricots and ginger into a pan and just cover with cold water. Bring to the boil and simmer, covered until the liquid has been absorbed and the apricots are soft. Purée this in a blender.
Lightly oil a frying pan and make 12 pancakes.
Heat the honey and orange juice in a small pan.
Pre-heat the oven to gas 5 (190°C). Spread 1 tbsp of apricot mix over each pancake and roll up, folding in the edges. Pack into a buttered, shallow, ovenproof dish, pour over the melted butter and cook for 20 minutes until heated through. Serve with the hot sauce.

recipes.Title: Kerala Seafood Curry
recipes.Ingredients:
100 g Salmon fillet, diced into 1 inch cubes
100 g Halibut/Cod/Pollock, diced
50 g Prawns
50 g Squid, cut into rings
100 g Mussels, cleaned

For the sauce:
50 ml Oil
1½ tsp Mustard seeds
2 Sprigs curry leaves
1 Onion, chopped
10 g Red chilli powder
3 Tomatoes, chopped
30 ml Tamarind pulp
150 ml Fish stock
150 ml Coconut milk
1 tsp Salt
recipes.Preparation:
First, make the sauce. Heat the oil in a deep pan and add the mustard seeds. When they crackle add the curry leaves and the onion and sauté until browning. Add the chilli powder and cook for a further 30 seconds. Add the tomatoes and tamarind pulp and cook until reduced.
Fry the fish for about a minute and add the fish stock, simmer and add the salt, add the coconut milk and simmer for a minute. As the sauce thickens, add the prawns, squid and mussels. Simmer for 2 more minutes and serve.

recipes.Title: Lamb Chops with Honey/Mustard Glaze
recipes.Ingredients:
4 Chump lamb chops
3 tbsp Olive oil
100 ml Dry white wine
Sprig of thyme, crumbled
A few sprigs of fresh coriander or mint, chopped
1 Chilli, finely chopped
Salt
2 tbsp Honey
2 tbsp Grain mustard
recipes.Preparation: Marinate the chops in the oil, wine, herbs and chilli for a minimum of 1 hour. Sprinkle with salt and cook over charcoal. Brush the top of each chop with a mixture of honey and mustard, cook for 1-2 minutes then repeat on the other side.

recipes.Title: Meen Pollichathu (Pomfret in Banana Leaf from the Taj Hotel, Mumbai)
recipes.Ingredients:
8 Pomfret fillets
50 g Onions
10 Curry leaves
5 g Ginger, chopped
5 g Garlic, chopped
2 g Green chillies, chopped
1 g Red chilli powder
1 g Turmeric powder
1 pinch Fennel powder
Juice of 2 lemons
50 g Tomatoes, chopped
20 ml Coconut oil
2 Banana leaves
Salt
recipes.Preparation:
Wash the pomfret fillets, apply the salt and set to one side.
Heat half the oil in a pan, add the garlic, chillies, curry leaves and ginger; cook.
Add the onions and sauté. Add the chilli powder, turmeric and fennel powder. Add the tomatoes, salt and lemon juice.
Apply the above sauce to the fillets and wrap them in the banana leaves.
Heat the remaining oil in a pan and sear the fish in the banana leaves then cook on low heat until the fish is cooked.
Serve in the banana leaves.

recipes.Title: Spicy lamb with lime and coconut
recipes.Ingredients:
225 g Lean lamb steaks, cut into thin strips
1 tsp oil
1 Clove garlic, crushed
½ inch cube of ginger, grated
15 ml Madras curry paste
2 Green chillies, finely chopped
Juice of ¼ lime with some of the rind, add to taste
25 g creamed coconut blended with 150 ml water.
Salt
Black pepper
1 tbsp Fresh coriander, chopped
recipes.Preparation: Heat the oil in a wok, add the lamb, garlic and ginger and chillies and stir-fry for 2 - 3 minutes. Stir in the curry paste then add the lime rind and juice, creamed coconut and seasoning. Bring to the boil and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes. Stir in the coriander and serve with rice or naan breads.

recipes.Title: Sausage Jambalaya
recipes.Ingredients:
450 g Chipolata sausages
1 tsp Oil
1 Onion, chopped
2 Cloves garlic, crushed
1 tsp Chilli powder
2 tsp Turmeric
225 g Rice
450 ml Stock
1 x 397 g Can chopped tomatoes
Salt
Black pepper
5 Spring onions, chopped
1 Courgette, sliced
½ Red pepper, chopped
100 g Button mushrooms, quartered
recipes.Preparation:
Halve each sausage. Heat the oil in a large saucepan and cook the sausage over a medium heat until browned.
Add the onion, garlic, chilli powder, turmeric and rice. Cook until the rice is opaque. Add the stock, chopped tomatoes and seasoning. Bring to the boil, cover  and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the remaining ingredients and continue to cook, uncovered, for another 10 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed.

recipes.Title: Sausage and Leek Tortilla (Omelette)
recipes.Ingredients:
4 Pork sausages, grilled and sliced
1 tbsp Oil
225 g Potatoes, chopped and cooked
2 Leeks, thinly sliced
3 Eggs, beaten
2 tbsp Milk
Salt
Black pepper
5 g Cheddar cheese, grated
recipes.Preparation:
Heat the oil in a pan, sauté the potatoes and leeks until softened. Add the sausage slices. Beat together the eggs, milk and seasoning. Pour over the sausages and cook gently, easing the cooked egg mixture from the pan so that uncooked mixture can take it's place.
Sprinkle with the cheese and brown under a pre-heated grill. Serve with salad and crusty hot bread.

recipes.Title: John's Liver Pâté
recipes.Ingredients:
240g Lean pork, top of leg, diced
115g Pig's liver, chopped
85g Chicken liver, chopped
230g Streaky bacon, chopped
1 Egg
1½ Glasses Dry white wine
1 tot Brandy
1 tbsp Tomato purée
½ Medium onion
3 Large cloves garlic
1 tsp Black pepper
30 whole black peppercorns
¼ tsp Ground cloves
¼ tsp Ground bay leaf
¼ tsp Ground nutmeg
1 tsp Salt
¼ tsp Cayenne pepper

Glaze:
170g Mushrooms, sliced
1 Red or green pepper, thinly sliced
4 whole bay leaves
Gelatine
recipes.Preparation:
Place all ingredients in a mixing bowl and blend together to make a coarse mix. Place the mix in a pâté bowl. Place the bowl in a baking tray and add 1 inch water. Bake at gas 3 for 2 hours.
Remove from the oven and fit the pâté press. Compress the cooked pâté and leave overnight in the refrigerator.
Make up the gelatine solution and add the mushrooms, pepper and bay leaves. Pour the gelatine mix over the top of the pâté and place in the refrigerator to set.

recipes.Title: Monkfish Tempura
recipes.Ingredients:
1 Monkfish tail fillet, cut into angled slices
1 Egg, white only
Dash of double cream
1 - 2 tbsp Plain flour seasoned with salt and pepper
Oil for frying
5 Spring onions
2 tbsp Soy sauce
2 tbsp Lemon juice
recipes.Preparation:
Pre-heat a deep-fat fryer to 190°C or heat about 2 inches oil in a wok.
Whisk together the egg white and cream and dip the fish pieces into this mixture, then coat the fish in seasoned flour, massaging the flour into the flesh so that it is covered in a thick crumbly layer.
Deep-fry the fish until crisp and golden brown; drain on kitchen paper. Deep fry the spring onion tops until wilted and drain also.
Mix together the soy sauce and lemon juice. Serve the tempura piled on a plate garnished with the onions and drizzle the soy mix over the top. Eat at once.

recipes.Title: Marinated Fried Monkfish Medallions
recipes.Ingredients:
700g Monkfish fillets
Salt
Black pepper
Flour for dredging
375 ml Oil
1 Large onion
60 ml Olive oil
1 Sprig rosemary
4 Bay leaves
1 tsp White wine vinegar
125 ml Dry white wine
125 ml Chicken stock
recipes.Preparation:
Remove the membranes and any dark portions from the fillets. Slice the fish in ½ inch thick medallions. Salt and pepper, then dredge in flour. Shake off the excess. In a large pan, heat the oil and fry the fish in batches turning once until lightly browned and cooked through, about 4 minutes. Drain on paper towels.
In a second pan, sauté the onions in the olive oil until pale golden but not browned, adding the rosemary, bay leaves, salt and pepper as the onion cooks, about 12 minutes over moderate heat. Add the vinegar, wine and stock and simmer for 10 minutes.
Arrange the medallions in two layers in a deep serving dish, distributing half the onion mixture over each layer. Allow the fish to marinate for at least 2 hours, warm and then serve.

recipes.Title: Monkfish with Walnut
recipes.Ingredients:
250 ml Walnut pieces, toasted
2 tbsp Black pepper
1 tsp Ground cumin, toasted
1 tsp Salt
6 Monkfish fillets, 170g each
3 tbsp Oil
recipes.Preparation:
Pre-heat the oven to gas 8 (230°C).
Place the walnuts, pepper, cumin and salt in a processor and whizz in pulses until powdery. Transfer to a shallow pan.
Place the fish in the nut mixture, turning to coat evenly. Gently press the mixture into the fish. Set aside.
Place a little oil in a pan and heat until very hot, then sear the fish for about 2 minutes per side until brown and crusty.
Transfer to the oven for about 5 minutes. Serve immediately

recipes.Title: Red Lentil Mulligatawny
recipes.Ingredients:
50 g Butter
2 Leeks, sliced
2 Large carrots, sliced
2 sticks celery, sliced
3 Cloves garlic, chopped
1 tsp cumin
1 tsp coriander
½ tsp turmeric
¼ tsp chilli powder
250 g Red lentils
1.3 litres Chicken stock
Salt
300 ml Coconut milk
1 squeeze of lemon juice
Toasted almonds to serve
recipes.Preparation:
Melt the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the leeks, carrots and celery and sweat for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until glossy and softened, putting in the garlic just before the end. Add the spices and stir, then the lentils and stir again. Pour in the stock, bring to the boil and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Place the soup in batches in a processor and purée, season and return to the pan. Add the coconut milk and gently heat without boiling, then season with a squeeze of lemon and more salt if necessary. Serve sprinkled with toasted almonds.

recipes.Title: Irish Soda Bread
recipes.Ingredients:
150 g white self-raising flour
150 g wholemeal flour or spelt flour
1 tsp bicarbonate of soda
2 tsp fine sea salt
1 tbsp black treacle
300 ml buttermilk
1 tbsp milk, for brushing
recipes.Preparation:
Heat the oven to 200°C.
In a large bowl, mix together the flours, bicarbonate of soda and salt.
Make a well in the centre and add the treacle and buttermilk. Mix it all together with a wooden spoon or your hands, until it just comes together. If it’s a little dry (this depends on your flour) add a splash of buttermilk or milk.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and shape into a rounded shape, around 5cm (2 inches) deep. Put it on to an oiled baking sheet.
Make a deep cross in the top of the bread using a wooden spoon. Brush with a little milk.
Bake for 25-30 minutes. The loaf should sound hollow when you tap the base. If not, return it to the oven for five minutes. Cool on a wire rack for 30 minutes.

recipes.Title: Gooey Lemon Pudding
recipes.Ingredients:
85 g Softened butter
175 g Caster sugar
Finely grated zest and juice of 3 medium lemons
3 Medium eggs, separated
100 g Self raising flour
225 ml Full-fat milk
Icing sugar and crème fraiche to serve
recipes.Preparation:
Pre-heat the oven to gas 4 (180°C). Grease a 1.4 litre (2½ pint) deep, oven-proof dish. Beat the butter, sugar and lemon zest together until creamy. Whisk the egg yolks lightly with a fork and beat into the butter mixture a little at a time.
Gradually stir in the flour, alternating with the milk and lemon juice. Whisk the egg whites until stiff and gently fold in (the mixture will look curdled at this point).
Pour the mixture into the buttered dish and cook for 30 to 45 minutes until risen and golden brown - it should still have a slight wobble when moved. Dredge with icing sugar and serve with crème fraiche.

recipes.Title: Pan-Fried Toffee Bananas with Coconut
recipes.Ingredients:
50 g Butter
6 Bananas
100 g Light brown sugar
5 tbsp Fresh orange juice
500 ml Vanilla ice cream
2 Bounty bars, chopped
recipes.Preparation:
Melt the butter in a large frying pan. Peel the bananas and cut in half diagonally. Fry the bananas for 3 -- 4 minutes until lightly browned, turning occasionally. Remove from the pan and place in serving dishes.
Add the sugar and orange juice to the pan and heat gently until the sugar dissolves. Simmer for 1 minute until the sauce becomes syrupy, then pour over the bananas. Serve immediately with scoops of ice cream topped with chopped Bounty bar.
recipes.Keywords: bananas, orange, coconut, chocolate, bounty bars

recipes.Title: Chickpea, Chilli and Coriander Soup
recipes.Ingredients:
225 g Chickpeas, soaked overnight in twice their volume of cold water
50 g Butter
1 tbsp Coriander seeds
1 tbsp Cumin seeds
6 Large cloves garlic, crushed
2 Red chillies, chopped
1 tsp Ground turmeric
Zest of 1 lemon
3 tbsp lemon juice
15 g fresh coriander leaves and stalks separated, chopped
200 ml Crème fraiche
Salt
Black pepper

Garnish:
1 mild red or green chilli, sliced into very fine hair-like shreds
recipes.Preparation:
Soak the chickpeas overnight then drain and rinse under a cold tap. Place them in a saucepan with 1.5 litres of boiling, unsalted water. Bring up to the simmering point, cover and cook for 1 hour or until the chickpeas are absolutely tender and squashy.
While they are cooking prepare the rest of the soup ingredients. The coriander and cumin seeds should be dry-roasted for 2 - 3 minutes and then ground in a pestle and mortar. Melt the butter in a pan and add the crushed spices along with the crushed garlic and chillies and cook over a low heat for about 5 minutes. Now add the turmeric, stir and heat  gently before removing from the heat.
As soon as the chickpeas are tender, drain them in a colander and reserve the cooking water. Transfer to a liquidiser with a little cooking water to make a fine purée. Now add the lemon zest, coriander stalks and spices from the pan along with another ladle of cooking water and blend once again until smooth.
Put everything back in a pan with the rest of the cooking water and bring to a gentle simmer. Stir, season and simmer for 30 minutes. When ready to serve, bring to the simmer, (do not boil). Stir in half the crème fraiche and the lemon juice, check the seasoning, then serve in soup bowls with the rest of the crème fraiche and scatter in the sliced chilli and chopped coriander leaves as a garnish.

recipes.Title: Celery Soup with Blue Cheese
recipes.Ingredients:
450 g Celery
50 g Butter
1 Potato, about 200 g peeled and diced
570 ml vegetable stock
1 Small onion, finely chopped
150 ml Single cream
150 g Blue cheese, rind removed and crumbled (Cashel Blue or Blue Wensleydale)
Salt
Black pepper

For the Croutons:
110 g Thickly sliced white bead, crusts removed and cut into small cubes
4 tbsp Walnut oil
recipes.Preparation:
Separate the stalks of celery and trim, reserving the leaves for garnish. The trimmed stalks should weigh 450 g. Scrub them in cold water and slice into thin slices.
Melt the butter in a large saucepan and stir in the celery, the chopped potato and the onion. Stir everything together to get a good coating of butter, then put on the lid and keeping the heat at minimum, allow the vegetable to sweat for about 10 minutes to release their buttery juices. Uncover and put in the stock and bring to simmering point. Cover again and cook gently for about 30 minutes. After that, check the tenderness of the vegetables; continue to cook if they are not tender.
Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the cream, then liquidise the soup along with the blue cheese until quite smooth. Return the soup to the pan and re-heat very gently. The soup should not be boiled.
Taste and season with the salt and pepper then serve the soup sprinkled with chopped celery leaves and crisp croutons. The croutons are made by frying the cubes of bread in the hot oil until golden brown and crisp.

recipes.Title: Chickpea Patties
recipes.Ingredients:
800 g Chickpeas, canned
4 Cloves garlic
1 tsp Cumin , ground
1 Small red onion, chopped
20 g Fresh coriander
2 tbsp Plain flour
Olive oil
recipes.Preparation:
Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then pat them dry with a kitchen towel. Put them in a food processor with the garlic, cumin, onion and coriander. Blend until smooth, then stir in the flour.
With floured hands, shape the mixture into 12 small round patties and chill in the fridge for 20 minutes.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat and fry the patties in batches for about 2 minutes per side until heated through and golden. Serve warm with parsley sprigs and lemon wedges.

recipes.Title: Pot-Roasted Pork in White Wine
recipes.Ingredients:
1.5 kg Loin of pork, off the bone and skin removed
Salt
Black pepper
1 tbsp Fennel seeds
3 Large knobs of butter
Olive oil
8 Cloves  garlic
1 Handful fresh rosemary
4 Bay leaves
1 Bulb of fennel, sliced
375 g of white wine, like Chardonnay
recipes.Preparation:
Pre-heat the oven to gas 6 (200°C). Tie the pork loin with string. Season generously and roll the meat in the fennel seeds until covered. Fry the meat in a pan in half the butter and a little olive oil until nice and golden.
Place the meat in a pot or casserole and throw in the garlic, herbs and wine. Put the lid on and roast for 1¼ hours. As the pork loin is off the bone it cooks quickly. Remove from the oven and allow the meat to rest on a plate. Finish the sauce in a pan, adding the rest of the butter. Remove any large pieces of rosemary stalk. Correct the seasoning and squash open a couple of the garlic cloves into the sauce.

recipes.Title: Walnut Ketchup
recipes.Ingredients:
25 green walnuts
2 Onions, chopped
2 Cloves garlic
1 tbsp Salt
600 ml Malt vinegar
4 Cloves
2 Blades  mace
8 Peppercorns
recipes.Preparation:
Chop the nuts and crush them in a mortar and pestle. Mix the onions and garlic with the nuts in a bowl. Add the salt and vinegar so that the nuts are well covered. Leave for 10 days, stirring daily.
Strain off the liquid into a pan. Add the spices and boil for 20 minutes. Strain and pour into bottles.

recipes.Title: Tomato Ketchup
recipes.Ingredients:
2.7 kg Tomatoes, skinned and chopped
1 Onion, chopped
3 Cloves garlic
1 tsp Paprika
1 tsp Cayenne pepper
Juice of 1 orange
1 tsp Salt
225 g Granulated sugar
300 ml White wine vinegar
recipes.Preparation:
Put the tomatoes into a preserving pan with the onion and garlic. Cook slowly until the onion is soft and the tomatoes are pulpy. Add all the other ingredients and continue to cook until the mixture has a thick creamy consistency.. Sieve or purée in a blender.
Pour the hot ketchup into clean bottles and cover, seal.

recipes.Title: Elderberry Catsup
recipes.Ingredients:
450 ml Malt vinegar
450 g Ripe elderberries, stripped off the stalks
4 Shallots, sliced
½ tsp Salt
1 Slice fresh root ginger
1 Blade mace
40 Peppercorns
12 Cloves
recipes.Preparation:
Boil the vinegar and pour over the elderberries in a glazed earthenware dish. Stand, covered, in the oven at gas ¼  (110°C) overnight. Strain.
Put the liquid into a pan with the shallots, salt and spices, then boil for 10 minutes. Leave to cool.
When cold, bottle and store for at least 1 year.

recipes.Title: Winter Relish
recipes.Ingredients:
450 g Cooking apples, peeled, cored and chopped
350 g Onions, chopped
700 g Blackberries
700 g Elderberries, stalked
600 ml White wine vinegar
1 tsp Allspice
1 tsp Cinnamon
2 tbsp Salt
6 Cloves
6 Peppercorns
450 g Granulated sugar
recipes.Preparation:
Place the apples, onions, blackberries and elderberries in a pan with the vinegar and spices. Bring to the boil and simmer for 15 - 20 minutes.
Rub through a nylon sieve, return to a clean pan. Add the sugar and stir over a gentle heat until dissolved. Bring back to the boil and boil rapidly for 20 - 30 minutes until thickened. Pour the relish into warm, clean jars and cover. Seal.

recipes.Title: Tomato Chilli Pickle
recipes.Ingredients:
10 Large red chillies
50 g Fresh root ginger
2 tsp Ground turmeric
2 tbsp Cumin seeds
Oil
300 ml Vegetable oil
10 Cloves garlic, crushed
225 g Sugar
2 tbsp Salt
300 ml Vinegar
1.8 kg Firm red tomatoes, cut into eighths
recipes.Preparation:
Grind the chillies, ginger, turmeric, cumin and a little oil together.
Heat the vegetable oil in a pan until quite hot. Stir in the ground mixture of spices and fry for about 1 - 2 minutes. Reduce the heat and add the garlic, sugar, salt and vinegar and stir. When the sugar has dissolved, add the tomatoes and cook until pulpy. Check the flavour and add more salt if necessary.
Leave to cool then pack in clean, airtight jars. Seal.

recipes.Title: Rowan Jelly
recipes.Ingredients:
1.8 kg Rowan berries, de-stalked
30 ml Lemon juice
Sugar
recipes.Preparation:
Put the berries into a preserving pan with water to just cover. Simmer for 15 - 20 minutes until soft. Add the lemon juice, strain through a jelly bag for several hours or overnight.
Measure the juice into a cleaned preserving pan. To every 600 ml of juice, add 350 g sugar. Stir over a gentle heat until the sugar has dissolved. Bring to the boil and boil rapidly until the setting point is reached.
Cool slightly, then pour the jelly into warm, clean jars and cover. Seal when cold. Store on a cool, dark place.

recipes.Title: Squash and Shrimp Soup
recipes.Ingredients:
4 x 175 g squashes or
1 x 700 g pumpkin (unpeeled weight), finely diced
4 Shallots, chopped
Olive oil
1 litre Chicken stock
200 g peeled, cooked brown shrimps
Salt
Black pepper
Nutmeg, ground, to taste
recipes.Preparation: Sweat the vegetables in a little olive oil until soft but not coloured. Season generously with salt, pepper and nutmeg, then add the chicken stock. Bring to the boil and simmer for 20 minutes. Then blend until smooth. Add the shrimps just before serving the soup. with pumpkin seed biscuits. The soup can be served with a dollop of sour cream or crème fraiche.

recipes.Title: Pumpkin Seed Biscuits
recipes.Ingredients:
200 g Plain flour
1 tsp Baking powder
Pinch of salt
Pinch of cayenne pepper
100 g oatmeal
60 g Butter, softened
80 g Mature cheddar cheese, grated
1 Egg
120 g Pumpkin seeds
A little milk
recipes.Preparation:
Sift the flour with the salt, cayenne pepper and baking powder, then add the oatmeal. Rub in the soft butter to make a fine sandy texture. Add the cheese, egg, 80 g of the pumpkin seeds and a little milk if needed. Bring together the dough, without over-working it. Wrap in film and refrigerate for 20 minutes.
Pre-heat the oven to gas 4 (180°C). Roll out the dough to a thickness of about 3 - 5 mm and cut to your preferred size. Brush with milk and sprinkle with the remaining pumpkin seeds. Place on a non-stick baking tray and bake for 15 - 20 minutes. Cool slightly before removing the biscuits from the tray.

recipes.Title: Lentil Soup with Vegetable and Ginger
recipes.Ingredients:
2 - 3 tbsp Oil
1 Large onion, finely chopped
2 Cloves garlic, crushed
2 inch piece of fresh ginger, finely chopped
1 Green chilli, finely chopped
1 tsp Ground cumin
1 tsp Ground coriander
1 Medium potato, chopped
2 Medium carrots, chopped
2 Sticks celery, chopped
225 g Red lentils
1.4 litres vegetable stock
Salt
Black pepper
1 Bay leaf
recipes.Preparation: Fry the onion, garlic, ginger and chilli for 5 minutes until soft, stirring frequently. Add the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the remaining vegetables and cook gently for 5 minutes. Add the remaining ingredients and bring to the boil. Cover the pan and boil rapidly for 10 minutes. Reduce the heat and simmer gently for 20 minutes. Stir frequently. Remove the bay leaf and blend until smooth.

recipes.Title: Cheesy Haddock and Prawn Pie
recipes.Ingredients:
600 ml Full cream milk
300 ml Double cream
450 g Salmon fillet
225 g Undyed smoked haddock fillet
175 g Uncooked, peeled prawns
3 Eggs, hard boiled and chopped
100 g Butter
40 g Plain flour
20 g Parsley, chopped
1.25 kg Potatoes, cut into chunks
50 g Cheddar cheese, grated
Salt
Black pepper
recipes.Preparation:
put the milk into pan, add the cream and bring to the boil. Add the haddock fillets and simmer for 5 - 6 minutes until the fish is just cooked through. Transfer the fish to a plate to cool slightly and strain the liquid into a jug.
When the fish is cool, break into large flakes discarding the skin and any bones. Put into a 1.75 litre shallow, ovenproof dish and scatter over the prawns and then the egg.
Melt half the butter in a pan, add the flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually stir in the cooking liquid and simmer for 5 minutes, season, stir in the parsley and pour over the fish. Leave to go cold.
Put the potatoes into a pan of cold, salted water; bring to the boil and simmer for 20 minutes. Drain well and mash. Stir in the remaining butter, the cheese and enough milk to make a spreadable mash. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Pre-heat the oven to gas 6 (200°C). Spoon the mash over the top of the pie and spread it out. Rough the surface with a fork and bake for 35 - 40 minutes until golden on top and bubbling underneath.

recipes.Title: Thai Pork Chops with Sweet & Sour Carrot Salad
recipes.Ingredients:
200 ml Coconut cream
3 Cloves garlic, crushed
1 tsp Minced red chilli
1 inch Fresh ginger, grated
3 tbsp Light soya sauce
Zest and juice of 1 lime
2 tbsp Caster sugar
4 Thick, boneless, spare-rib pork chops

For the Salad:
3 Large carrots, peeled and grated into thin strips
2 tbsp White wine vinegar
1 tbsp Caster sugar
1 Medium, hot red chilli, finely chopped
2 tsp Nam Pla
20 g Coriander, finely chopped
recipes.Preparation:
Make the marinade by combining the coconut cream, garlic, chilli, ginger, soya sauce, lime zest and juice and sugar in a liquidiser until smooth. Place the chops in a shallow dish and pour over the marinade, turning a few times to coat. Cover and chill for 6 hours or overnight.
Lift the chops out of the marinade and shake off excess liquid. Cook over a BBQ or in a pan for 7 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, mix the vinegar, sugar, red chilli and Nam Pla together in a bowl. Just before serving, add the grated carrot and coriander and mix well. Serve with he pork chops.

recipes.Title: Thai-Style Fish with Ginger
recipes.Ingredients:
Four 150 g White fish fillets, lemon sole, sea bass or brill, skinned
1 tsp salt
1 bunch Spring onions
2 tbsp Dry sherry
2 tbsp Dark soya sauce
2 Cloves garlic, finely chopped
2 cm fresh root ginger
1 Hot red chilli, finely chopped
Juice of 1 lime
1 tsp Caster sugar
1 tbsp Nam Pla
Fresh coriander to garnish
recipes.Preparation:
Set up a steamer or put a rack into a wok or pan with a lid. Pour in enough water to come 5 cm up the sides and bring to the boil. Dry the fish fillets and sprinkle with salt, rubbing it in by hand. Trim the onions. Finely chop 2 of them for the dressing and set aside. Arrange the remainder on a heatproof plate and add the sherry and soya sauce. Place the fillets on top and scatter with garlic and ginger. Put the plate of fish on the rack, cover tightly and steam for 5 - 15 minutes, depending on the thickness of the fillets; they should be opaque and flaking slightly, but still moist.
Meanwhile, place the reserved onions in a small serving bowl with the chilli, lime juice, sugar and Nam Pla, stirring until the sugar dissolves. When the fish is cooked, remove the plate from the rack and transfer the fish fillets to serving plates. Drizzle over some of the Thai dressing and garnish with coriander sprigs. Serve with boiled rice and the rest of the dressing.

recipes.Title: Indian Fish Curry
recipes.Ingredients:
1 fillet of Pollock, skinned and cubed
2 tbsp oil
1 tsp mustard seeds
1 tsp cumin seeds
1 tsp coriander seeds
1 green chilli with seeds, finely chopped
6 curry leaves
2 cloves garlic
1 bunch spring onion, chopped
½ tsp haldi *turmeric)
½ pack coconut cream
recipes.Preparation:
Put oil in wok and heat. Put in mustard, cumin and coriander seeds, the chilli and curry leaves. Fry until the seeds have popped. Add onion and garlic, fry for a few minutes.
Add haldi, stir. Add fish and cook until fish just loses translucence.
Add coconut, stir in and add a small amount of water to thin to a creamy consistency.

recipes.Title: Murgh Boti Kebab
recipes.Ingredients:
340 g chicken breast , cut into cubes
½ tsp salt
1 tbsp lemon juice
½ tbsp fresh ginger, grated
1 clove garlic, crushed
½ tsp ground cumin
½ tsp paprika
½ tsp cayenne pepper
3 tbsp tomato ketchup
black pepper
¼ tsp haldi
oil
recipes.Preparation:
Put chicken into a bowl and add salt and lemon juice. Prick the chicken and rub in.
After 20 mins. add ginger, garlic, cumin, paprika, cayenne and ketchup, lots of black pepper and haldi. Mix well, cover and refrigerate overnight.
Brush with oil and BBQ.

recipes.Title: Subzi Poriyal
recipes.Ingredients:
400 g fresh beetroot, boiled in salt water and cooled, cubed
50 ml oil
1 tbsp black mustard seeds
75 g red shallots or red onions, finely chopped
4 fresh green chillies, finely chopped
75 g grated coconut
salt
pepper
recipes.Preparation:
Peel the beetroot and chop into small cubes or thin slices.
Heat the oil, add mustard seeds and fry until they pop. Stir in the onions and the green chillies and sauté for 2-3 mins. Add grated coconut and stir fry gently until brown.
Stir in the beetroot and season with salt and pepper.

recipes.Title: Kande Ki Sabzi
recipes.Ingredients:
100 ml oil
1 tsp cumin seeds
1 tbsp garlic
1 tbsp ginger purée
500 g baby onions

Masala:

1 tsp red chilli powder
2 tsp ground coriander
2 tsp ground haldi
50 g natural yoghurt
salt to taste
recipes.Preparation: Mix masala ingredients with 50 ml water. Heat oil, add cumin seed and fry until they pop. Stir in ginger and garlic purée and cook for a short time. Stir in the masala and then the onions and coat with masala. Add more water and simmer until onions are tender but do not lose their shape.

recipes.Title: Chana Dall
recipes.Ingredients:
113 g chana dall
550 ml water
¼ tsp haldi
1 thin slice of unpeeled ginger
½ tsp salt
pinch garam masala
1½ tbsp oil or ghee
¼ tsp cumin seeds
1 clove garlic
¼ tsp red chilli powder
recipes.Preparation:
Bring dall to the boil in water. Add ginger and haldi. Cover and simmer for 1½ hours.
During last ½ hour, stir every 5 mins. to stop sticking. Add salt and garam masala and stir.
Heat oil and put in cumin seeds, then garlic until brown, then chilli.
Stir and pour all in dall and mix.

recipes.Title: Onion Bhaji (Pyaz Bhaji)
recipes.Ingredients:
1  tbsp gram flour
1 tbsp white flour
½ tsp haldi
½ tsp ground cumin
1 tsp garam masala
1 pinch cayenne pepper
1 egg
1 large onion, halved and sliced
1 tbsp chopped fresh coriander leaf (cilantro)
salt to taste
recipes.Preparation:
Put the flours into a large bowl and blend in the spices. Make a well in the centre and add the egg; stir to form a gluey mix. Add the onion and cilantro and stir to coat.
Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown.

recipes.Title: Eggs Benedict
recipes.Ingredients:
4 Eggs
2 English muffins
50 g Crispy, smoked bacon
Soft butter
Hollandaise sauce
recipes.Preparation:
Pre-heat the grill. Bring a small pan of water to just below simmering point, break the eggs into it and gently cook for 1 minute. Remove the pan from the heat, put a lid on and let the eggs finish cooking for a further 6 minutes.
Split the muffins and toast on both sides. Grill the bacon until crisp, butter the muffins, place the bacon on top then add the eggs. Pour the hollandaise sauce over and return to the grill for a minute. Serve immediately.

recipes.Title: No-Panic Hollandaise Sauce
recipes.Ingredients:
3 tbsp Crème fraiche
1 tsp cornflour
2 Egg yolks
¾ tbsp White wine vinegar
½ tbsp Lemon juice
50 g Softened butter
recipes.Preparation: Spoon the crème fraiche into a small saucepan then add the rest of the ingredients except the butter. Whisk together and over a medium heat bring to simmering point, whisking continuously, until the sauce has thickened. Now remove the sauce from the heat, taste and add more seasoning, vinegar or lemon as required. Now whisk in the butter.

recipes.Title: Pla Mueg Pad Prik (Squid with Chilli)****
recipes.Ingredients:
500 g Squid, sliced
1 Medium onion, finely chopped
2 Cloves garlic, crushed
2 Red chillies, finely chopped
2 tbsp Oil
1 tsp Ginger, fresh, shredded
1 tbsp Nam Pla
1 tbsp White wine or sherry
1 tbsp Oyster sauce
2 tbsp Spring onions, chopped
Salt
Black pepper
1 tbsp Coriander to garnish
recipes.Preparation:
Stir fry the onion and garlic, Add the ginger and squid and stir fry at high heat for 1½ minutes until they change colour.
Drizzle the fish sauce and wine down the sides of the pan. Add the oyster sauce, chillies, salt and pepper and spring onions and stir fry for 1 minute. Serve garnished with fresh cilantro.

recipes.Title: Pla Kapong Khing (Fish in Ginger Sauce)
recipes.Ingredients:
750 g Fish, whole, scaled - snapper or sea bass
125 g Plain flour
Salt
Black pepper
1 Cucumber

Ginger sauce:
4 mushrooms, wide cap, cut into strips
4 Spring onions
1 Red chilli
3 tbsp ginger in vinegar
2 tbsp oil
60 ml vinegar
60 g Sugar
1 tsp Salt
170 ml Fish stock
2½ tsp Cornflour
recipes.Preparation:
Scale and slash the fish. Mix the flour, salt and pepper in a poly bag and shake the fish in the mixture to coat thickly.
Deep fry the fish for 3 minutes then lift out and cool for a few minutes. Return the fish to the oil and cook again for 3 - 4 minutes. Place on a rack to drain.
Mince the spring onions and chillies and sauté for a few minutes then add the mushrooms. Mix in the remaining ingredients and bring to the boil, then simmer until thickened and clear.
